title: Review of c31's crawler no-division negative: no division replicates on fresh seed 2 at rho_s 0.25 and 0.3 (0 persistent splits, 4-5 merges, 2 bodies left), but rho_s 0.3 does not freeze every cell: on seed 2 the largest cell polarizes at t~2.4, crawls and absorbs its neighbours
summary: c31's crawlers-from-noise world, labkit, t=0-14, seed 2. rho_s 0.25: the random domains round up into about 8 cells, the larger ones polarize and crawl, crawlers absorb static cells, 24 -> 2 bodies, 1 split (not persistent), 4 merges, max 2.2 body lengths. rho_s 0.3: the same coarsening into round cells, then the largest cell polarizes at t~2.4 (rho cap on one side, pack_rs03/sheet.png), crawls across the box and absorbs three cells by t~11; labkit counts 0 tracks moving >= 1 body length because tracks break at each absorption; 1 split, 5 merges, 2 bodies at the end; the small disks stay static and unpolarized.

observations.finding: pack_rs025 and pack_rs03 FACTS: 0 persistent splits; sheets show coarsening by absorption, no fission

seeds_run.result: pass for no division at rho_s 0.25 and 0.3
contradicts 'rho_s 0.3 freezes every cell': one large cell polarizes and crawls

verdicts.limitation: The negative (no division at rho_s 0.2-0.3) holds. The crawling window is size-dependent rather than ending at rho_s ~0.25: at 0.3 a large enough cell still self-polarizes on seed 2, so c31's frozen seed 0 likely had no cell above the size threshold. One seed per value; rho_s 0.35 not re-run.
